Create translation guidelines document defining tone, terminology, and cultural adaptations for Brazilian Portuguese.

Update CSS variables for AutomatizaSE color scheme using CSS custom properties. Create brand helper methods for dynamic brand name insertion. Update application.html.erb and other layout files with AutomatizaSE branding. Implement brand-aware email templates using ActionMailer with AutomatizaSE styling. Update manifest.json and PWA configurations. Create brand constants in Rails initializers for consistent brand name usage. Update meta tags and Open Graph data for AutomatizaSE.

tasks.title: Configure Stripe Integration for Brazilian Market
tasks.description: Adapt existing Chatwoot Stripe integration from self-hosted cloud configuration to standard self-hosted setup, specifically configured for Brazilian Real (BRL) payments and local market requirements
tasks.details: Adapt the existing Chatwoot Stripe billing system from cloud configuration to standard self-hosted deployment. The billing system already exists and functions - focus on modifying configuration rather than creating new integration. Configure existing Stripe setup for BRL currency and Brazilian market requirements. Adapt existing webhook endpoints for self-hosted environment. Implement Brazilian tax ID (CPF/CNPJ) collection and validation using cpf_cnpj gem within existing billing flow. Configure existing Stripe Customer Portal for Brazilian users with Portuguese interface. Ensure existing payment methods work with Brazilian requirements (credit cards, PIX if available). Adapt existing error handling for Brazilian banking regulations. Verify existing webhook signature verification works in self-hosted setup. Configure existing retry logic for failed payments with Brazilian banking considerations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test adapted Stripe integration with Brazilian test cards and payment methods. Verify existing webhook endpoints work correctly in self-hosted environment. Test CPF/CNPJ validation integration with existing billing system. Validate currency formatting displays correctly in BRL within existing UI. Test existing payment failure scenarios and retry mechanisms work with Brazilian requirements.

tasks.title: Design and Implement Subscription Plans System
tasks.description: Adapt the existing Chatwoot subscription plans system to implement the 4 specific AutomatizaSE pricing tiers: Gratis (Free), Pro (renamed from Startup), Business, and Enterprise. Add 7-day free trial functionality for all paid plans before Stripe billing begins.
tasks.details: Adapt existing Chatwoot Plan model to implement the 4 specific AutomatizaSE plans: Gratis (R$0/mês, up to 2 agents, 1 WhatsApp inbox, 500 conversations/month), Pro (renamed from Startup - R$95/agent/month with additional channels), Business (R$195/agent/month with teams and automation), and Enterprise (R$495/agent/month with custom AI and integrations). Implement 7-day free trial period for all paid plans (Pro, Business, Enterprise) before Stripe billing begins. Modify existing plan features and limits to match AutomatizaSE specifications. Update plan comparison logic and upgrade/downgrade paths between the 4 tiers. Configure trial period logic that delays Stripe charges for 7 days on paid plan subscriptions. Update plan serializers for API responses including feature matrices. Configure specific plan limits: agents (2 for Gratis, unlimited for paid plans), inboxes (1 WhatsApp for Gratis, multiple channels for others), conversations (500/month for Gratis), and data retention (30 days for Gratis). Implement feature flags for channel access (Email, Facebook, Instagram, SMS, Telegram, etc.), advanced features (Teams, Automation, Campaigns), and integrations (CRM, Captain AI, External APIs).
tasks.testStrategy: Test adaptation of existing plans to AutomatizaSE specifications. Verify plan renaming from Startup to Pro works correctly. Test 7-day free trial implementation for paid plans - ensure Stripe billing is delayed. Verify Stripe products are updated correctly for each pricing tier. Test plan comparison showing feature differences between Gratis, Pro, Business, and Enterprise. Validate specific plan limits are enforced: agent limits, conversation limits, channel restrictions, and retention periods. Test upgrade/downgrade paths between all plan combinations. Verify feature flags correctly enable/disable functionality based on plan tier. Test free Gratis plan doesn't create Stripe charges. Test trial period expiration triggers proper Stripe billing.

tasks.description: Adapt Chatwoot's existing onboarding system to implement AutomatizaSE's 4-tier pricing model with 7-day trial period and Brazilian Portuguese localization
tasks.details:
Adapt Chatwoot's existing onboarding flow to support AutomatizaSE's business model. Current system starts accounts as default and migrates to enabled features via script after subscription. Need to implement:

**Core Adaptations:**
- Analyze current Chatwoot onboarding flow and account creation process
- Implement 7-day trial period for all plans before payment required
- Integrate trial period with Stripe billing delay mechanism
- Adapt existing feature enablement scripts for AutomatizaSE plan structure

**Plan Structure (Updated):**
🆓 Plano Grátis (Free): Permanent free tier with basic features
🚀 Plano Pro: Mid-tier paid plan with enhanced features
💼 Plano Business: Advanced business features
🏢 Plano Enterprise: Full enterprise capabilities

**Implementation Requirements:**
- Modify existing account creation to support trial period
- Update feature enablement scripts to match new plan tiers
- Integrate Stripe billing delay for trial management
- Localize existing onboarding UI to Brazilian Portuguese
- Adapt plan-specific feature restrictions in existing system
- Modify existing welcome flows for AutomatizaSE branding

**Trial Period Integration:**
- All new accounts start with 7-day trial access to selected plan features
- Stripe billing configured with 7-day delay
- Automatic plan downgrade to free tier if no payment after trial
- Trial countdown and upgrade prompts in existing UI
tasks.testStrategy: Test adaptation of existing Chatwoot onboarding flow for all 4 AutomatizaSE plans. Verify 7-day trial period works correctly with Stripe billing delay. Test account creation process maintains existing functionality while adding trial features. Validate feature enablement scripts properly restrict/enable features based on plan selection. Test trial expiration scenarios and automatic downgrade to free tier. Verify existing onboarding UI properly displays in Portuguese. Test integration between trial period and payment processing.

tasks.title: Implement WhatsApp Integration using Evolution API
tasks.description: Create a dedicated WhatsApp inbox integration using Evolution API with Baileys, enabling custom inbox creation, QR code scanning, SMS verification, and connection management for unofficial WhatsApp instances.
tasks.details: Implement a comprehensive WhatsApp integration module using Evolution API REST endpoints. Create a new inbox provider class inheriting from Chatwoot's base inbox structure. Set up API client for Evolution API communication with proper authentication and error handling. Implement instance creation functionality using Baileys through POST /instance/create endpoint with custom instance names. Build QR code generation and display interface by calling GET /instance/connect/{instanceName} and rendering the base64 QR code image in the frontend. Implement SMS code verification as alternative connection method using POST /instance/code endpoint. Create connection status monitoring using GET /instance/connectionState/{instanceName} with real-time updates via WebSocket or polling. Add webhook configuration for receiving messages using POST /webhook/set endpoint pointing to Chatwoot's webhook handler. Implement message sending capabilities using POST /message/sendText and POST /message/sendMedia endpoints. Create inbox configuration UI allowing users to set custom names, choose connection methods (QR/SMS), and monitor connection status. Add proper error handling for API failures, connection timeouts, and instance management issues. Ensure proper cleanup of disconnected instances and implement reconnection logic. Store Evolution API credentials and instance configurations securely in encrypted application credentials.
tasks.testStrategy: Create comprehensive test suite including unit tests for Evolution API client methods, integration tests for instance creation and connection flows, and end-to-end tests for complete WhatsApp inbox setup. Test QR code generation and display functionality with mock Evolution API responses. Verify SMS verification flow with test phone numbers. Test message sending and receiving through webhook endpoints using ngrok for local development. Validate connection status monitoring with simulated connection state changes. Test error handling scenarios including API timeouts, invalid credentials, and network failures. Perform load testing with multiple concurrent WhatsApp instances. Verify proper cleanup of disconnected instances and test reconnection scenarios. Test inbox configuration UI across different browsers and screen sizes. Validate webhook security and message processing accuracy.
